reasons: The search box comes before the list. The single matching row shows the address, subject, a Failed mark with its word, the latest event "Bounced", the provider, and a time with its UTC zone, so the support person can see the reset email and its status. The page uses the product's words (Activity, Account) and makes no retry promise or invented cause.
